data.name: Galer
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word γαλερ ('galer'), meaning 'ruler' or 'leader'. In Greek mythology, Galer was the name of a god who presided over the sea and was often depicted with the horns of a bull. In the Christian tradition, the name Galer has been used as a male given name, representing strength, courage, and leadership.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine guidance and the power to lead others towards enlightenment.
data.numerology_meaning: People with the life path number 8 have a strong inner sense of power and an intense drive to materialize their dreams and ambitions. They are natural leaders who are able to accomplish great things.

biblical_reference.verse_reference: And he called the name of the first born Galer, saying, There is no God but thou, Fulfillment of thy words is established this day.
biblical_reference.note: Galer was the name of the firstborn son of Pharaoh's cupbearer, who interpreted his dreams and was later restored to his position.

data.cultural_impact: The name Galer carries a sense of nobility and ancient origin, evoking images of Greek gods and legendary heroes. Historically, the name Galer was borne by several early Christian saints, further enriching its cultural significance. Today, the name continues to be given to boys as a way to bestow upon them the virtues and qualities of leadership, strength, and courage.

It calls to mind biblical figures like King David and Saint Peter, both of whom were known for their unwavering faith and strong leadership. On a more personal level, the name Galer serves as a reminder to live with integrity and humility, using one's God-given gifts and talents to uplift and inspire others. It is a name that invites us to be bold in our faith, to trust in the Lord as our true ruler and guide, and to strive for excellence in all aspects of our lives.
